spec.assertion: it.skip — resource-pool init has no direct-damage observable; enemy ammo removal is inert (no enemy entity). Only matters as a depletion gate, which is unasserted.

buffApply atkPct=30.5 AND attackDamagePct=30.5 casterIdx=velvet, every targetIdx=velvet; teammate totals byte-identical when removed. Fails nearest-wrong: allies-scope (teammates would move) and drop-the-block (buff vanishes).
buffApply casterAtkPct=25.2 exists AND atkPct=25.2 does NOT — discriminates '25.2% of skill-user ATK' (flat caster-scaled) from atkPct (target's own ATK).
buffApply chargeDamagePct=100.8 to >1 ally slot AND chargeDamageMultPct=100.8 absent (additive pts, not base-scaled mult); removing it moves teammate totals (proves ally-scope).

self attackDamagePct=15.03 fires iff FB normal-count>=50 (conditional non-vacuity). Payload: if driver counts ALL normals (not FB-only) it over-fires when fbNormals<50 -> the else-branch RED flags the divergence.
removing the flatDamage(400.92)+15.03 block never increases velvet total (monotone) and drops the buff. Rider disposition (noFb/noRange/no-core) is a FLAG, not magnitude-asserted.
buffApply attackDamagePct=34.52 self on burst-cast (also the velvet-casts non-vacuity proxy); removing the swap block removes it. Nearest-wrong: keyed off velvet's burst, not any team FB.
velvet shot count differs vs a no-swap counterfactual — proves the swap changes weapon cadence/ammo (base SR 69.04/shot -> 7% swap weapon). Cadence itself is a FLAG (kit-silent).

fixtures: controlComp('velvet', true): liter B1 / crown B2 / velvet(carry, actually B2) / helm B3, Fire boss, focus velvet. Velvet is Burst II so the carry slot holds a B2 and the FB chain is liter -> one B2 -> helm; the non-vacuity block asserts a fullBurstStart occurs AND velvet's burst-only 34.52% self-buff appears (proves velvet — not crown — was the B2 that cast), otherwise every in-FB (S2a) and burst (Bst) assertion would be silently vacuous. helm kept (true) — it is the B3 that completes the chain here, so it cannot be dropped.
